cues: A constructor is a member function with the same name as the class and no return type.
It runs automatically when an object is created, to give the data its starting values.
You can have a default constructor and a parameterised one.
The destructor, with a tilde, runs automatically when the object is destroyed.
And a static member has one copy shared by every object: here, a count of students created.
